rationale: The description specifies deterministic usage-control and reporting operations: throttling at data caps, creating quota add-ons, enforcing restrictions with notifications, launching plans, generating event records, and providing tiers. These are conventional functions with no affirmative AI/ML signal.
evidence_spans: Real-time usage control for customers on ATT and T-Mobile networks, used by Tracfone that provides the following:
Enforces fair usage by throttling network speed when customers reach their data caps
Generates Event Detail Records to provide reporting capabilities
conflict_response: The service framing does not leave this at a category or entitlement label: the description gives concrete control and reporting behavior, including throttling, quota management, notifications, and event-record generation. That sufficiently establishes conventional functionality, so the final negative is supported despite the blind proposal's weaker route.
